ambiguities.statement: “No open questions” and deterministic defaults coexist with open blockers, deferred families, and mandatory release reverification; a product-decision versus implementation-evidence distinction is likely but unstated.
“After live Plans and allowed PlanUnit indexes stabilize” lacks a stability criterion, actor, duration, and oracle.
The change summary is nonchronological, so file order cannot safely imply recency or precedence.
“Whole-MVP but capability-probed/gated” does not identify the probe, gate state model, unsupported-host outcome, or GUI presentation.
Mandatory OpenAI/Codex subscription-backed image generation lacks exact account/route identity, entitlement test, and unavailable-route fallback.
Backend fallback timing/control/persistence and official-release authority, freshness, recording, and mismatch behavior are unspecified.
Web fixtures claim validator coverage without naming the validator command or required passing result.
“Authoritative map” is bounded by owner-doc canon, but conflict behavior is unstated; “registered” also variably suggests routing metadata, artifact existence, or validated activation.

builder_discretion.statement: Detailed behavior belongs to named primary owners; the index does not grant free invention.
Backend fallback activation/recovery remains locally discretionary unless an owner defines transitions.
Capability-probe implementation and unsupported-host presentation remain locally discretionary unless Docker/Hosts owners define them.
Release-reverification source, timing, evidence, and mismatch response must not be invented without owner authority.
The web fixture executable oracle is unspecified; artifact presence cannot be inferred as passing behavior.
Conflict resolution among multiple primary owners must defer to referenced DRY, decision, and progression contracts.

claims.statement: This is the authoritative Plans navigation/canonicalization map, compliant with DRY_Rules, Contracts_V0, Document_Packaging_Policy, Decision_Policy, and Progression_Gates; it requires “Puppet Master” naming and deterministic defaults but does not override or re-own owner-plan detail.

assistant-memory-subsystem is the Assistant-only memory SSOT; GitHub_Integration is registered; bootstrap planning/Plan Document/plan-to-node boundaries derive from pldg-20260610-001-ledger-plan-system; Goal_Runtime_System owns native Goal Mode runtime/control-plane behavior; Orchestrator Goal Runtime Flow derives from pldg-20260616-002-orchestrator-goal-runtime-flow.

Planning_Ledger_System owns the durable semantic-audit closure registry and reopen policy; Plan_Document_System owns deterministic finding keys and closure-matrix validation; bootstrap documents consume them. Governance artifacts may refresh only through an explicit seal after live Plans and allowed PlanUnit indexes stabilize.

PlanCompile remains design-only/disabled, Automated_Testing_System is testing SSOT, plans_to_code_handoff.schema.json is a design-only draft, and governance registration is metadata-only. PRD/Planning bootstrap compile remains Plans/index-only. prd_planning_runtime_contracts and its schema define strict runtime shapes, with pm-prd-planning-runtime-validate.py in standard gates. These registrations authorize no WorkNodes, NodeSeeds, queues, dispatch, GoalRuns, implementation files, generated governance, or production builds.

chain-wizard documents and CW-*/CWF-* PlanUnits are compatibility/source-lineage only; Gemini CLI is retired, Gemini Direct remains API-key-backed, Antigravity CLI replaces the CLI Google/agent route, provider-model catalogs and route/model/account-specific readiness are mandatory, and media routes include mandatory subscription-backed plus official API-key OpenAI image generation. PM History, vision_bridge/see_image, and Teach/Teacher routing derive from pldg-20260626-001-feature-name; PMConcept.html remains non-final lineage.

Docker/Hosts is a native Slint page/lab reached from Docker Manager and cross-surface links, with docker_manager owning its side-panel/command namespace and capability-probed/gated runtime families. PMConcept reconciliation and production wiring artifacts inventory/disposition controls while PMConcept remains noncanonical implementation state. The target is Rust 1.96.1 plus Slint 1.17.1, Winit+Skia default, FemtoVG-wgpu and software fallbacks, and first-build WASM canvas GUI through a trusted local daemon; runtime work must reverify official stable releases.

The blocker registry, gate matrix, generated buildability report, node-readiness PNC-019 state, and pm-implementation-readiness generator/validator/self-tests govern readiness. Artifact existence, semantic closure, node-readiness reporting, or passing validators do not prove buildability; Approve And Build, PNC-019, and buildability_gate_passed remain disabled/false while blockers or the lifecycle boundary remain open. Non-executable evidence closes only named spec/schema/validator/fixture lanes, not runtime_lifecycle or clean_room_harness.

Executor_Protocol solely owns pm.execution_unit_context 1.0.0 and named consumers reference it. Contracts_V0 §1.2 owns persisted pm.event.v0; event_record.schema.json is Draft 2020-12 version 1.0.0; storage-plan owns seglog/redb persistence, replay, retention, migration, compatibility, and payload registration. storage_value_registry materializes launch-critical value identities; its validator enforces parsing, ownership, versions, no-secret fields, and false buildability, while deferred families require owner, reason, and reopen condition.

web_operation_contracts.schema.json owns WebOperation, provider projection, permission/cache/egress, async-job, citation/research, browser state/action, GUI card, and testing shapes. No-secret registry/projection examples cover PM-native reader, direct API, MCP, model-native, CLI/server bridge, and coding-agent routes without mutating local config. Receipts preserve v3 lineage by basename/hash/size/finding ID without absolute paths or secrets. Fixtures cover progress, denial, partial/fallback/batch, timeout/non-queue, autonomous actor policy, research closure, routing parity, and negative security/browser/citation behavior; findings coverage maps every v3 ID to evidence and validator surfaces. Governance refresh and live projection sync remain separate lanes, with no runtime/build authorization.

Models_System owns active context-window, max-token, fallback-chain, capability-provenance, and requested/effective capability fields; Contracts_V0 owns only the snapshot-reference envelope; assistant-chat-design and Provider_OpenCode consume them; platform_specs references cannot be active authority.

Anti-drift review has a fixed ten-owner-document reading order followed by seven primary consumers. Owners reconcile before consumers; stale tier/request-era canon cannot remain a peer alternative; summaries/checklists reconcile last.

The owner map is routing-only: primary owners carry canon, while cross-owner, adjacent, stale-consumer, and already-identified-owner entries are reconciliation companions. Context enumerates contract, storage, UI, chat, run-graph, HITL, executor, usage, file, runtime-artifact, orchestrator, mixed-era, and impacted-document seams.

cross_window_seams.statement: The owner-map guard begins at core line 67; its operative rule and seam catalog begin in context and continue into WIN-00-plans-index-0002.
Anti-drift sequencing crosses owner contracts into primary GUI/run/usage/file consumers.
Readiness crosses the blocker registry, gate matrix, buildability report, PNC-019 state, and validation script; none alone proves buildability.

GUI currentness/wiring crosses PMConcept artifacts, Rust/Slint targets, fallback, WASM, trusted daemon, and GUI/command/runtime-artifact owners.
Web behavior crosses schema, provider projections, receipts, fixtures, findings coverage, runtime artifacts, commands, GUI, actors, permissions, models, storage, evidence, and testing.
Provider/model currentness crosses provider routing, runtime release reverification, Models_System, Contracts_V0, and platform_specs retirement.
Mixed-era and impacted-doc reconciliation crosses Contracts_V0, storage-plan, FinalGUISpec, UI commands, Executor, assistant chat, usage, and Orchestrator.

invalid_reason: Substantive reviewer agent identities were reused across successive window/role assignments, violating the Fresh Agent Isolation Protocol.

negative_space_observations.statement: The index repeatedly denies authorization for WorkNodes, NodeSeeds, executable queues, runtime dispatch/launch, implementation files, manifests, GoalRuns, production builds, repairs, and governance-seal artifacts in these lanes.

Runtime lifecycle and clean-room harness remain open; EventRecord, storage-value, and non-executable evidence cannot imply broad runtime, GUI, security, behavioral, persistence, provider-stream, or buildability closure.
Fallback backends, capability gates, and a trusted daemon are named without selection triggers, failover/recovery transitions, trust establishment, permission-denial behavior, or degraded GUI states.
Scripts and validator ownership are named, but exact commands, outputs, failure classifications, retry behavior, and passing evidence are generally absent.
Anti-drift sequencing lacks local multi-owner conflict arbitration, version/hash pinning, stale-input detection, interruption/resume behavior, and executable reconciliation completion proof.

Web receipts/projections protect secrets and local configuration, but authentication, credential lifecycle, cache retention, egress enforcement, malicious-source handling, and concurrency/idempotency behavior are not stated here.
Event/storage retention ownership is routed, but replay ordering, corruption handling, atomicity, concurrency, idempotency, cancellation, and migration-failure behavior are absent locally.
Retired/source-lineage artifacts are barred from active truth, but the diagnostic or gate response to lingering consumer references is unspecified.
